messages:
deploy-bot: preflight alert — v2 canary (5%) detected TTL/cache semantics mismatch vs v1. flagged users: 1.2k, risk: client-side stale data or rapid revalidation. canary paused. https://deploys/reports/3999991234
Maya: saw this in stage earlier, v2 defaults TTL to 0 unless client sends x-client-ttl. v1 used 60s default.
Sam: oof. mobile SDK 1.x relies on server TTL. many clients haven't updated.
Eric: pin request: can we pin mobile traffic back to v1 until we ship an sdk patch?
Nina: +1 for pin. are we able to add a server-side compatibility header to restore 60s for client-version < 2.0.0?
Maya: yes, we can add a quick shim in gateway: if x-client-version < 2.0.0 || missing -> set Cache-Control: max-age=60 and x-client-ttl:60. low risk change.
Sam: timeline? we need a fix in prod within the hour or keep the canary paused for longer.
Maya: I can push the shim to canary within 20m, then to prod after smoke.
deploy-bot: canary remains paused per operator request. awaiting manual resume.
Eric: release notes callout needed — this is a compatibility footgun. add a bold note: "Default cache TTL changed in v2; update older clients or expect different caching behavior."
Nina: also add migration steps: how to clear client cache, how SDKs should respect x-client-ttl, and the recommended server shim until clients update.
Sam: rollback criteria: if 5xxs or client error rate on mobile > 1% over 5m, full rollback to v1. ops runbook updated?
Maya: updating runbook now. will include exact curl to verify Cache-Control header and a deploybot command to resume when green.
Eric: can we avoid a full rollback by doing a phased pin: mobile platform -> pin to v1 via routing for 2 hours, then monitor?
Nina: that reduces blast radius, +1. ops: prepare pinlist for mobile tenants.
Sam: tagging @oncall for eyes once shim is in prod.
Maya: shim pushed to canary, tests pass. requesting prod rollout. logs: `gateway: shim set Cache-Control=60 for client-version < 2.0.0`
deploy-bot: prod rollout scheduled in 5m. canary metrics: client revalidation events down 82% after shim.
Eric: great. I'm drafting the release note blurb and a short FAQ for SDKs.
Nina: once prod is live, we'll resume canary and keep the pin window open for 2 hours.
Sam: thanks everyone. follow-up: add a non-blocking note to CHANGELOG about TTL semantics and file an SDK augmentation ticket. :thumbsup:
Maya: on it — will post the deploy IDs and the resume command here when done.
deploy-bot: prod rollout complete. canary resumed. operator: @Sam, manual resume executed at 3999991289.
